comments.content: The condition `is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class)` will fail for backed enums (e.g., `int|string` backed enums) because they implement `\BackedEnum`, not `\UnitEnum`. Since `\BackedEnum` extends `\UnitEnum`, use `is_a($value::class, \UnitEnum::class, true)` or `is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class, true)` with the third parameter set to `true` to allow interface checking. Alternatively, use `$value instanceof \UnitEnum` directly on the instance.
